summary: Silynxcom Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing the notice, proxy statement and proxy card for its Annual General Meeting to be held November 24, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. Israel time at its Netanya offices, the standard foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a US annual meeting proxy. Record date is October 29, 2026. Agenda items are routine: re-appointing Ziv Haft, BDO member firm, as independent auditor through the next AGM with board-set compensation, and re-electing Nir Klein and Yafit Keret as Class III directors for three-year terms. The board unanimously recommends FOR each proposal; each needs a simple majority. No special-situation event, transaction or forced departure; no deal terms or arb angle.
